acceptanceCriteria: A proposal schema and acceptance ledger are specified with requirement IDs.
Harvest output is byte-identical across runs on a fixture suite.
An unaccepted proposal never reaches compile, proven by test.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Hand-declared blocks will not scale. V1: a deterministic harvester proposes blocks from existing Playwright specs and page objects (E6), proposals carry their source spans and never govern until accepted into .corvint/e2e-acceptances.json by a human, plus a bounded repair loop for broken locators that also only proposes.
